content.text: Scrolling through Prime Video and not sure what to pick? The library is huge, so I made a short list of the best movies on Amazon Prime Video. Most of them are Amazon originals, which means they are on Prime Video in almost every country, including Oman and the rest of the Gulf. At the end you will find popular films that come to Prime in some countries too.
Amazon original movies

Ben Affleck directs and Matt Damon stars in the true story of how Nike signed a young Michael Jordan and created the Air Jordan shoe. Air is funny, smart and feels good from start to end, even if you do not care about basketball.
2. Road House (2024)

Jake Gyllenhaal plays a former UFC fighter working as a bouncer in the Florida Keys. Big fights, beautiful beaches and Conor McGregor as the wild villain. One of the most watched films on Prime Video.
3. Saltburn (2023)

Barry Keoghan plays an Oxford student who is invited to spend the summer at the huge country house of a rich classmate, played by Jacob Elordi. Saltburn is dark, strange and impossible to stop watching. It is for adults only.
4. Red One (2024)
When Santa Claus is kidnapped, the head of the North Pole security, Dwayne Johnson, has to team up with a hacker played by Chris Evans to save Christmas. A big action comedy for the whole family.
5. The Idea of You (2024)
Anne Hathaway plays a 40-year-old single mother who falls for the 24-year-old singer of the world's biggest boy band. A warm, grown-up romance and one of the best romantic movies on Prime.
6. The Tomorrow War (2021)
Chris Pratt is sent 30 years into the future to fight an alien invasion that is wiping out humanity. Big action and big effects.
7. Tom Clancy's Without Remorse (2021)
Michael B. Jordan plays a Navy SEAL on a revenge mission in the world of Jack Ryan. A tight action thriller.
8. Samaritan (2022)
Sylvester Stallone plays an old garbage man who a boy believes is a superhero who disappeared 25 years ago. A different kind of superhero movie.
9. Coming 2 America (2021)
Eddie Murphy returns as Prince Akeem, who travels back to New York to find the son he never knew he had. A sequel to the 1988 comedy classic.
Award winners from Amazon Studios
10. Manchester by the Sea (2016)
Casey Affleck won the Oscar for best actor as a man who has to look after his teenage nephew after his brother dies. A sad but beautiful drama.
11. Sound of Metal (2020)
Riz Ahmed plays a heavy-metal drummer who starts to lose his hearing. It won two Oscars and is one of the most moving films on Prime Video.
12. One Night in Miami (2020)
Regina King's film imagines one night in 1964 when Muhammad Ali, Malcolm X, Sam Cooke and Jim Brown met in a hotel room. Great acting and great conversations.
Popular films that come to Prime in some countries

Many big Hollywood and Indian films are licensed to Prime Video for a time, only in some countries. Search for these in your Prime Video app; if they show "Included with Prime", you can watch them at no extra cost:

items: Top Gun: Maverick: Tom Cruise back in the fighter jet.
Everything Everywhere All at Once: the multiverse film that won seven Oscars.
Elvis: Austin Butler as the king of rock and roll.
Smile: a horror film about a curse passed on with a smile.
Black Adam: Dwayne Johnson as the DC anti-hero.
Kantara: the Kannada hit by Rishab Shetty, with Hindi, Tamil and Telugu versions.
